summary: The parameterized endpoint argument correctly combines the accepted nesting p_z + lambda_alpha D_z subset M_{alpha a_z}(C_z), origin symmetry, the depth bound gamma_d alpha a_z, and r_z <= gamma_d a_z to obtain admissible residual-selector weights alpha r_z; the factors 2^{-n}, 2^{n-rho}, and hence alpha 2^{-n} are correct. For edges, the D_e gauge condition yields an exact endpoint displacement decomposition, whose metronoid witnesses have the prescribed graph midpoint in the mixed-integer set. The halfspace orientation charges each midpoint atom exactly once, bounds the total charge entering fiber z by alpha r_z, and uses one metronoid depth bound for that whole fiber charge, so the resulting measure is genuinely halfspace-dominated. Its support lies on the graph of s, giving residual rank zero and the claimed alpha 2^{-n} edge bound. The H(C) conversions and the alpha = 1/4, lambda_{1/4} > 1/5 specialization give exactly the constants in (7)-(10). The parameterized endpoint estimates and all edge estimates are nonredundant beyond the already accepted fixed endpoint specialization.
